slice: native A-to-B candidate switch, identity-change clearing, keyboard section disclosure, and viewed-vs-formal labelling on fixture projections
authority: Lead-assigned task-7 (parallel wave 2) under the MP-INS1 card and DC-MP-INS1. Fixture/Desktop-local observation only; no Runtime projection is claimed and no product behaviour was reinterpreted.

baseline.worktree: the observation binary was built from a clean detached worktree at abf2310; the main worktree carried only other lanes' uncommitted files (palette.rs, IMPLEMENTATION_MASTER_PLAN.md) plus this new evidence directory

build.command: cargo build --locked --release -p cos-desktop (CARGO_TARGET_DIR and TEMP/TMP under C:/dev/cos-desktop-verification/ins1-20261108, outside the repository)
build.why_release: the assignment asked for the release binary; the earlier debug startup stack-overflow was not re-tested against this target

baseline.product_change: NONE: every enumerated row behaved as the contract requires, so no product or test source was changed and no speculative surface edit was made

profile_isolation.evidence: the application exits before creating a window with 'COS Desktop instance ownership unavailable; startup refused (create-directory)' for profiles under C:/tmp (also under a C:/dev sibling directory and a LOCALAPPDATA subdirectory), for both the debug and the release binaries; a profile inside the workspace target tree starts and renders exactly as observed here
profile_isolation.fallback_used: C:/dev/cos-desktop/target/ins1-20261108/profile (isolated from the user's real profile, inside the workspace target tree which is not tracked)
profile_isolation.interpretation: INFERENCE / NOT_DIAGNOSED: writes by the launched application appear to be confined to the workspace in this environment; no OS setting was changed and the product was not modified to work around it

input_route.launch: Start-Process <release exe> --fixture with LOCALAPPDATA set; no display, DPI or accessibility setting changed
input_route.candidate_switch: UIA InvokePattern on the real dock button (AutomationId contains fixture:candidate/a or fixture:candidate/b); this is the accessibility activation path on the running window, not a synthetic mouse click
input_route.section_disclosure: UIA SetFocus on the section header, then a real ENTER key through SendKeys after confirming the application window was foreground; UIA ExpandCollapsePattern was exposed but Expand() did not change the rendered state (recorded, not used)
input_route.capture: CopyFromScreen over the application window rectangle while it was foreground; PNG 1296x839
input_route.cleanup: only the application PID this driver started was stopped, then the native lock was removed; the lock owner file named impl-typ1 before release

native_a_to_b_candidate_switch.initial: no candidate is viewed: inspector caption '候補は表示されていません'; candidate-dependent sections state '候補は選択されていません。'
native_a_to_b_candidate_switch.select_a: inspector caption '閲覧中の候補（この画面での選択）: A — 正式採用ではありません。正式採用は実行基盤から通知されます。'; dock row A '… — A 閲覧中・キーボード操作対象'
native_a_to_b_candidate_switch.select_b: inspector caption '閲覧中の候補（この画面での選択）: B — 正式採用ではありません。正式採用は実行基盤から通知されます。'; dock row A '… — A 比較対象', dock row B '… — B 閲覧中・比較対象・キーボード操作対象'
native_a_to_b_candidate_switch.side_effect: the second selection also opened the Compare surface ('作業領域：候補を比較', sides 'A: A' and 'B: B', buttons 'A側を変更'/'B側を変更'/'比較を閉じる'). This is the documented dock D-3 behaviour (first selection fills side A, second fills side B and switches to Compare), recorded as observed, not as a defect.

identity_change_clearing.before_switch: Evaluation (評価) expanded for candidate A: UIA '評価 — …' expand=Expanded, a '評価の詳細' group present, and the captured image shows 判断 不合格（FAIL）, 評価主体 HARNESS, 確信度 0.55, visual_quality 58 score_0_100
identity_change_clearing.after_switch: after selecting B the Evaluation header is expand=Collapsed, the '評価の詳細' group is absent, and the captured image shows no evaluation field lines (no 0.55 and no 58 anywhere in the inspector)
identity_change_clearing.reopen_b: re-opening Evaluation shows 確信度 0.62 and visual_quality 66 for B, i.e. the values now belong to the newly viewed identity
identity_change_clearing.fixture_cross_check: the two observed payloads match the fixture exactly (a: FAIL / HARNESS / 0.55 / visual_quality 58; b: FAIL / HARNESS / 0.62 / visual_quality 66), so the values are not inferred locally

keyboard_section_disclosure.observed: with the application window foreground, UIA SetFocus on a section header followed by a real ENTER key toggled it from Collapsed to Expanded: Evaluation for A (Collapsed→Expanded), Evaluation for B (Collapsed→Expanded), Goal (Collapsed→Expanded); the corresponding '…の詳細' group appeared and the final header states were goal=Expanded, eval=Expanded, evidence/refinement/outcome=Collapsed
keyboard_section_disclosure.limit: UIA FocusedElement reported the window ('COS Desktop') rather than the header after SetFocus, so header-level focus reporting is NOT_MEASURED; the key event itself is what changed the rendered state

observed: inspector: '閲覧中の候補（この画面での選択）: A/B — 正式採用ではありません。正式採用は実行基盤から通知されます。'
dock caption: '反復ごとの候補 — 閲覧中・比較対象はこの画面での選択です。正式採用とは異なります。'
compare caption: 'この画面での比較対象。正式な採用結果ではありません'
context bar: '正式な結果: 不明 — 正式な結果の情報を受け取れていません'

no candidate carries the formal marker '正式採用（実行基盤から通知）' in any captured state (occurrences across all dumps: 0), and the fixture's Runtime best_candidate_ref (fixture:candidate/d) is never presented as formally selected

measurements.uia_raw_view: RawViewWalker returned the identical node set and text as the control view (axr-02 byte-identical to ax-02, axr-04 to ax-04); the section detail field values are therefore not exposed through UIA and were read from the captured images only
